#!name=航旅纵横
#!desc=合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
#!format=sgmodule

# 来源 ext-wool-0212 / 航旅纵横 / 奶思
# 来源 ext-surge-0405 / 航旅纵横去广告 / 佚名

[Rule]
URL-REGEX,"^http?:\/\/(discardrp|startup)\.umetrip\.com\/gateway\/api\/umetrip\/native",REJECT,extended-matching

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/oss\.umetrip\.com\/fs\/advert\/polite/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^http?:\/\/(discardrp|startup)\.umetrip\.com\/gateway\/api\/umetrip\/native/i then reject(404)

[Script]
移除首页广告 = type=http-response, pattern=^http?:\/\/(114\.115\.217\.129)|(home\.umetrip\.com)\/gateway\/api\/umetrip\/native$, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/Umetrip/Umetrip_remove_ads.js

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% home.umetrip.com, discardrp.umetrip.com, startup.umetrip.com, oss.umetrip.com, 114.115.217.129
